# Cuddy

> Cuddy ("Cuddy: Top 5 Friends") is an iPhone app for teens and young adults, ages 13 and up. You pick your top 5 friends from your contacts, post the list to your Snapchat or Instagram story, and find out who put you in theirs.

- Pick your top 5: choose up to 5 friends from your contacts and order them. Inviting one friend by text (or subscribing) unlocks spots 6 to 10.
- Post it to your story: share your list to Instagram or Snapchat in one tap. Friends appear the way you saved them, first names and nicknames only.
- See who likes you back: when someone puts you in their top 5, you get an anonymous notification such as "A girl put you in her top 5". A weekly subscription ($2.99/week in the US) shows who it was.
- It's mutual: when two people pick each other, both find out, free.
